diagnosis: The Socket.io dynamic workspace namespace with Redis adapter validates JWT signature authenticity in its connection middleware, but fails to check whether the authenticated user is an authorized member of the workspace ID specified in socket.nsp.name. Any user with a valid platform JWT can connect to any workspace namespace and receive live board states.

Host: collab.enterprise.internal:4001

Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_token>
